title: Conspuez les Anglais! Perfide Albion!
html_source:
Roughly:
Damn the English! Treacherous island!

The White Cliffs of Dover may have given rise to the name Albion (Ancient Greek: Ἀλβίων), the oldest known name of the island of Great Britain.
